fuente.titulo: Pope Leo: I will undergo surgery soon to remove nodule in my lung

titular: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung nodule surgery
bajada: Vatican says nodule is at early stage; operation set at Rome's Gemelli Hospital
caption: Pope Leo XIV has announced he will undergo surgery in the coming days to remove a localized nodule in his lung, describing it as being at a very early stage and well-localized. The procedure will take place at Rome's Gemelli Hospital. Source: Vatican News, Oct. 11, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: Exterior of Rome's Gemelli Hospital at dusk, a solitary figure in white papal attire glimpsed entering through a side door, positioned in the upper right third, left and center space open and calm.
